scenes.title: First in Her Class
scenes.summary: After a brief backstage flash-forward at the Twelve Singers finale, top media student Bu Xiaogu introduces herself and compares graduation to jumping into a boiling hotpot.
scenes.location: TV studio backstage and media college campus

scenes.title: Waiting Outside Professor Fang's Office
scenes.summary: Qin Xiao waits outside the college for Bu Xiaogu so they can go in together, and Professor Fang tells both students their first thesis drafts have passed.
scenes.location: media college entrance and Professor Fang's office

scenes.title: How the Internship Feels
scenes.summary: Professor Fang asks how the TV network internship is going; Xiaogu loves it while Qin Xiao feels disappointed, and Fang warns them that permanent spots are scarce.

scenes.title: Advice in the Corridor
scenes.summary: Professor Fang briefly encourages Qin Xiao to consider Yunhai TV if she does not stay at DTS.

scenes.title: Xingtian Wants an Intern
scenes.summary: Co-producer Wang Er arrives on campus, gets directions from Xiaogu, and asks Professor Fang for a student intern to join the Twelve Singers team at Xingtian.
scenes.location: campus walkway and Professor Fang's office

scenes.title: Choosing Xingtian Over the Network
scenes.summary: Xiaogu stuns Qin Xiao by giving up her prestigious TV station internship to join Xingtian Entertainment so she can learn from star producer Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: Touring Studio One
scenes.summary: Wang Er welcomes Xiaogu to Xingtian Entertainment and shows her the broadcast control room and the bustling Studio One where Twelve Singers is taping.

scenes.title: Backstage Costume Rush
scenes.summary: Crew members scramble backstage over a singer's stage dress while Xiaogu pitches in to help.

scenes.title: Finding Her Desk at Xingtian
scenes.summary: Wang Er teases Xiaogu for working before getting paid, explains Xingtian's competing production departments, and shows her to her desk outside Chun Yuqiao's office.

scenes.title: The Boss Whose Name Nobody Speaks
scenes.summary: Xiaogu shares her sour-plum soda with exhausted assistant Xiaoye, who warns her never to speak Chun Yuqiao's name aloud and pities her for having to attend his meetings.

scenes.title: Four Hundred Hours of Video
scenes.summary: Wang Er tells Xiaogu to prepare for next week's meeting with Chun Yuqiao by studying stacks of files and four hundred hours of show recordings.

scenes.title: He Already Read It on the Plane
scenes.summary: Senior producer Xingzi calls the production meeting; Wang Er asks Xiaogu to present guest-star data, but Chun Yuqiao cuts them short because he already read the report on his flight.

scenes.title: Not a Nursery for Interns
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao tells Wang Er not to bring untrained interns into production meetings; Xiaogu calmly asks about the rules, then worries in the hallway that she was impolite.
scenes.location: chief editor's conference room and hallway

scenes.title: Guessing Favourite Celebrities
scenes.summary: Sent by Wang Er to liaise with data partner Fentuan Tech, Xiaogu meets eccentric president Ji Xiu, who insists on guessing which celebrity Xiaogu secretly admires.
scenes.location: Xingtian office and Fentuan Tech office

scenes.title: Back from Fentuan Tech
scenes.summary: Xiaogu returns to Xingtian shaken by Ji Xiu's uncanny questioning before Wang Er calls her into his office.

scenes.title: Everything Speaks Through Data
scenes.summary: Xiaogu reports to Wang Er and Xingzi that Ji Xiu's data points to pop idol Yin Zhengyu, matching the chief editor's own shortlist.

scenes.title: Shadowing Producer Xingzi
scenes.summary: Xingzi smoothly contacts Yin Zhengyu's agency and offers to mentor Xiaogu, while Wang Er tells Xiaogu that good work is the best thank-you.
scenes.location: Wang Er's office and Xingtian corridor

scenes.title: Overhearing a Suspicious Phone Call
scenes.summary: Xiaogu overhears Ji Xiu discussing Xingtian's plans on the phone and tells Qin Xiao there is a spy, though Qin Xiao urges her to look out for herself first.

scenes.title: Close the Door from Outside
scenes.summary: Suffering from stomach pain, Chun Yuqiao calls out to close his office door; Xiaogu steps inside by mistake and gets ordered out before he steps out to hear what she wants.

scenes.title: Xiaogu Pitches a Backup Plan
scenes.summary: Worried that Yin Zhengyu is too sought-after, Xiaogu proposes booking his younger brother Yin Jiaxi as a backup guest; Chun Yuqiao approves the idea on the spot.

scenes.title: Trusting the Intern
scenes.summary: Wang Er hands Xiaogu his personal industry contacts to carry out her backup plan herself and tells her to stop doubting herself because she is an intern.

scenes.title: Dirtying Xiaogu's Notebook
scenes.summary: While meeting Xiaogu for lunch, Ji Xiu spills on Xiaogu's notebook and apologises as she discreetly glances at the notes inside.

scenes.title: Old Colleagues, Current Rivals
scenes.summary: Rival producer Xie Ling taunts Chun Yuqiao about their competing music shows taping in three days, and Chun Yuqiao coolly offers to let Xie Ling take Yin Zhengyu.

scenes.title: Both Guest Plans Fall Through
scenes.summary: After rival ME signs Yin Zhengyu, Xiaogu calls Yin Jiaxi's agent for Plan B, only to learn that Yin Zhengyu's new exclusive contract bars his brother from appearing too.

scenes.title: Already Taping Right Now
scenes.summary: Tearfully blaming herself for leaking Plan B in her notebook, Xiaogu apologises to Xingzi, who laughs and reveals that Chun Yuqiao is already taping the revival show.

scenes.title: Left Out of the Real Plan
scenes.summary: Xiaogu tells Wang Er that Chun Yuqiao moved the taping earlier; as host Wen Simo introduces real guest mentor Liu Fan on stage, Wang Er realises he was kept in the dark.
